chapters.title: One product record for the company

takeaways: Product information management gives the whole company one shared product definition instead of conflicting copies in each department.
Product masters, product dimensions and variants model product families, and the configuration approach must be chosen early because it cannot be converted later.
Releasing a shared product to each legal entity lets local teams add their own settings, while data entities and Dataverse distribute product data to other apps.
hook: When sales, the warehouse and the online store each keep their own product data, customers get the wrong item. This episode explains Dynamics 365 product information management in plain English for supply chain teams and Dynamics newcomers. You will learn how product masters, variants, categories and released products keep one product story across the business.
